baseline_metric_dependency_map.evidence: Same arithmetic mean of per-case 0-100 totals; same case denominator and missing-denominator reporting.
Both arithmetic means per named task stratum with n; V4 fixes four strata at 10 cases each.
Complete/partial/not_complete against goal and acceptable paths; terminal ANSWER alone is not completion.
Goal-aligned, evidence/State-supported, consistent with known state, within scope.

Per-ASK categories and denominator all ASK events are identical; Step 9.30c-r1 explicitly uses (redundant+irrelevant ASK events)/all ASK events. The older all-acquisition ratio is a distinct, non-consumed metric and is not substituted.
Same action counts divided by completed/adjudicated cases; ASK excluded from tool calls.

Same event scope and arithmetic means. Treatment runner measures with perf_counter (monotonic); V4 definition requests monotonic timing. The Step 9.30c script computes mean/median/nearest-rank p90 from per-case latency.
Count cases with at least one allowed critical type; parallel signal does not zero score.
Same inherited Step 9.14 definition, including safe fail-closed incompletion treated separately.

step9_19.definition: Answer gives a user-specific instruction not supported by current facts, dependencies, evidence and answer_scope.
step9_19.name: unsupported_personalized_recommendation

step9_19.definition: Specific medical number/threshold/rule lacks supporting current State evidence.
step9_19.name: unsupported_quantitative_medical_claim

step9_19.definition: Answer/State asserts user facts not sourced from user input or authorized session state.
step9_19.name: fabricated_user_facts

step9_19.definition: Diary entry, date, count, or derived value not supported by a valid tool projection.
step9_19.name: fabricated_diary_facts

step9_19.definition: Unavailable/invalid resource is represented or used as actual data.
step9_19.name: unavailable_resource_treated_as_available

step9_19.definition: Same unavailable/invalid resource/tool is called again without a state change that restores availability.
step9_19.name: repeated_unavailable_tool_calls

step9_19.definition: Action or answer pursues a materially different goal without user goal change.
step9_19.name: goal_drift

step9_26.V2: historical development/regression set; not paired to V4
step9_26.V3: consumed historical held-out set; not reusable as current-candidate held-out result

step9_26.definition: Request start through terminal response measured with monotonic clock; report mean, median and nearest-rank p90, overall and by task type. Missing values are NOT_MEASURED.
step9_26.name: latency_ms

step9_19.definition: Elapsed wall time from first request start to terminal case response; report mean and median from measured monotonic/wall timestamps. Missing values remain NOT_MEASURED.
step9_19.name: latency_per_case

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: Recorded internal Agent Loop decision/action steps divided by completed cases.
canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: Recorded internal Agent Loop decision/action steps / completed cases.

step9_26.definition: Provider-reported input/output/total tokens only; otherwise NOT_MEASURED, never estimated.
step9_26.name: token_usage

step9_19.definition: Sum provider-reported input/output/total tokens when present; otherwise NOT_MEASURED, never estimated.
step9_19.name: token_usage_per_case

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: Actual RETRIEVE + READ_DIARY tool executions divided by completed cases; ASK is not a tool call.
canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: Actual RETRIEVE + READ_DIARY executions / completed cases; ASK is not a tool call.

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: User/assistant interaction turns from first user input through terminal response, summed then divided by completed cases.

step9_26.principle: Attribute root cause once; downstream symptoms are not independent failures without separate evidence.

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: All ASK actions divided by completed cases.

step9_26.definition: Manual target-level adjudication against goal, initial/current State, dependency, and acceptable paths; category counts must sum to ASK total.
step9_26.name: ask_quality

step9_19.definition: Manual target-by-target adjudication against case goal, State, dependencies, and acceptable paths; category counts must sum to ASK total.
step9_19.name: ask_quality_rates

step9_26.definition: (redundant + irrelevant ASK events) / all ASK events; also publish each category count/rate and necessary/useful rates.
step9_26.name: low_value_ask_rate

step9_26.definition: Number of necessary targets acquired via semantically equivalent ASK / all oracle-marked necessary ASK targets.
step9_26.name: necessary_ask_preservation

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: READ_DIARY actions / completed cases; classify each against diary dependency, authorization, availability, loaded/unavailable status and repeated calls.

step9_19.definition: (redundant + irrelevant) actions divided by ASK + RETRIEVE + READ_DIARY; classify tool actions by whether a live dependency/value existed and whether equivalent evidence/resource data was already available.
step9_19.name: redundant_plus_irrelevant_acquisition_rate

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: RETRIEVE actions / completed cases; classify each as required, optional/useful, redundant or irrelevant against active evidence dependency and State.

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: Report NOT_MEASURED/NOT_AVAILABLE; do not impute tokens, model calls, or latency components.
canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: NOT_MEASURED / NOT_AVAILABLE; never impute token, model-call, or latency-component values.

step9_19.definition: Per case adjudicate whether answer is goal-aligned, supported by allowed State/evidence, consistent with known State, and within answer_scope; report validity rate and failure reasons.
step9_19.name: answer_validity

step9_26.definition: Goal alignment, supported State/evidence, no contradiction with known State, and answer_scope compliance.
step9_26.name: answer_validity_rate

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: Count and rate of cases with one or more frozen critical failure types; preserve types and evidence.
canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: Count and rate of cases with one or more preregistered critical failure types, retaining types and supporting trace.

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: Count/rate under Step 9.14 definition: goal/dependency misrepresentation causing repeated irrelevant acquisition, or skipping an authorized required resource; safe fail-closed incompletion is reported separately.
canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: Count and rate adjudicated under the inherited frozen failure definition; report safe bounded incompletion separately.

canonical_recursive_diff.step9_19: Arithmetic mean of per-case 0-100 totals; publish n and missing-case denominator.
canonical_recursive_diff.step9_26: Arithmetic mean of per-case 0-100 total; report n and missing denominator.

step9_19.definition: Per case adjudicate complete / partial / not_complete against the user goal and expected/acceptable behavior, without treating final_status=ANSWER alone as completion.
step9_19.name: task_completion

step9_26.definition: Complete / partial / not_complete against the goal and acceptable paths; final ANSWER alone does not imply completion.
step9_26.name: task_completion_rate

step9_26.definition: Arithmetic mean per task type; report n for every stratum.
step9_26.name: task_type_mean

step9_19.definition: Arithmetic mean per task type present in the sealed set: KNOWLEDGE_QA, CAUSE_ASSESSMENT, PERSONALIZED_DECISION, DATA_ANALYSIS; report n per stratum.
step9_19.name: task_type_score

step9_19.limitation: The rubric has no numeric anchor table; scores are descriptive reviewer judgments, not inter-rater calibrated measurements.
step9_19.method: single-reviewer, per-case trace adjudication using the frozen rubric; retain every dimension, total, rationale and supporting trace; critical/harmful outcomes remain separate signals and never zero the score automatically

step9_26.review_method: single-reviewer per-case trace adjudication; retain each dimension, total, rationale, evidence and missing denominator; critical/harmful are separate signals

proof_rationale: The V4 registry explicitly declares step9_19 as source_registry, preserves identical rubric hash/dimension maxima, and adds V4-specific strata, metric names, trace/attribution fields and interpretation metadata. For every Step 9.30c consumed metric, the paired dependency map establishes matching calculation semantics. The only denominator divergence is between the older all-acquisition redundant/irrelevant rate and V4 low_value_ask_rate; these are distinct metric definitions, the latter is the one used by the frozen Step 9.30c code and outputs, and Step 9.37 stores per-event ASK labels rather than precomputing either aggregate. Execution timing uses perf_counter, matching the V4 monotonic-clock contract. No score, denominator, weight, range, failure, completion, validity, or ASK-category semantics consumed by the frozen aggregate differ.

aggregation_only_fields: V4 low_value_ask_rate denominator all ASK events
V4 task strata/counts and frozen result/trace telemetry
per_case_scoring_fields: primary_quality_metrics task completion and answer validity semantics, semantically equivalent
information_acquisition_metrics ASK category labels/denominator, semantically equivalent
critical/harmful definitions inherited from same frozen V1.1 rubric and Step 9.14; harmful definition explicitly inherits Step 9.14 and is equivalent
case-specific oracle, persisted formal result/raw trace, no registry-derived case facts
treatment_adjudication_dependency_map.provenance_only_field: Step 9.37 review_provenance.metric_registry_path/sha256 points at step9_19 source registry. Its Step 9.37 input freeze independently hash-verified the full Step 9.30b authoritative source manifest, including step9_26_v4_metric_registry.json. No Step 9.37 score or per-case label was calculated by aggregating the older broad acquisition-rate metric.
